title: Arizona ex parte renewal share, August 2026
question: What will Arizona's ex parte renewal share be for August 2026 in the original (O) submission row when CMS first publishes it?
resolutionSource: CMS, State Medicaid and CHIP Eligibility Processing Data (data.medicaid.gov)
resolutionRule: Resolves to Arizona's ex parte renewal share for the August 2026 reporting period, computed from the original (O) submission row in CMS dataset 5abea2e0-3f8e-4b49-a50d-d63d5fd9103c when CMS first publishes it. Numerator and denominator as published; share computed to one decimal. Subsequent revisions do not change resolution.
